name: faculty-canvas-messaging-educator
description: Teach faculty to use Canvas audience selection and messaging workflows safely through explanations, fictional practice, independent checks, and recovery rehearsal.

interface.longDescription: Guides faculty through plain-language, fictional-data learning experiences for safe AI use, audience selection, approvals, wording, links, uncertainty recovery, accessibility, and value comparison without connecting to Canvas or sending messages.
interface.defaultPrompt: Teach me the Canvas messaging workflow using fictional data. Start with a concise overview, then guide me through the practice case one decision at a time and check my reasoning before revealing answers.
